owners.metaDescription: List your weekend house with Vikendly: free listing, commission only on bookings we bring, an in-person visit and a “Verified in person” badge.
owners.title: Rent out your weekend house to people looking for exactly that
owners.intro: Vikendly is a small, carefully chosen catalogue of weekend houses. Guests see the full price and clear house rules, and we find and check the guests for you.

apply.title: Apply
apply.text: Fill in a short form. We call you back within a few days.

visit.title: We meet
visit.text: We visit the house, agree on the details and can help with photos.

publish.title: We publish
publish.text: We add prices, capacity, rules and photos, and show you the listing before it goes live.

guests.title: We send guests
guests.text: For every request we call you to check the dates. You confirm, we tell the guest.

guests.title: Guests who know what they are booking
guests.text: Guests see the full price and house rules before asking, so there is no haggling and no surprises.

control.title: You decide
control.text: You set the prices, dates, minimum nights and whether parties and pets are allowed.

verified.title: “Verified in person” badge
verified.text: Once we visit, your listing gets a badge that gives guests confidence.

noHassle.title: No work with the listing
noHassle.text: We write the description, prepare the photos and answer guests’ questions.

owners.priceText: You only pay a commission on bookings we bring you. No monthly fee and nothing up front. We agree on the commission when we meet and put it in writing before the listing goes live.

pricePoints.commission: Commission only when a guest comes through us
pricePoints.noLockIn: Remove your listing whenever you like

need.photos: Photos of the house (or we take them during the visit)
need.capacity: How many people can stay overnight and, if allowed, for parties and gatherings
need.prices: Weekday and weekend prices, and for smaller groups if you like
need.rules: House rules: check-in, check-out, parties, pets, smoking
need.phone: A phone number we call about requests (guests don’t see it)

exclusive.q: Can I also rent out the house on other websites?
exclusive.a: Yes. Just let us know when dates are taken, so we don’t offer them to guests.

payment.a: You and the guest agree on payment and any deposit, on your terms. We pass on checked requests.

visit.a: We can publish a house without a visit, but it only gets the “Verified in person” badge once we have been there.

change.q: Can I change prices and rules later?
change.a: Of course. Tell us the changes and we update the listing, usually the same day.

remove.q: How do I take my house off the site?
remove.a: Just tell us. We remove the listing straight away, at no cost.

owners.formText: Send us the basics. We will call you to meet and agree on the details.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: A question about a house, a request or working with us? Get in touch.
contact.guestsText: The quickest way is to send a request from the house page. We check the dates with the owner and get back to you.
contact.ownersText: Want to rent out your weekend house with Vikendly? See how it works and apply.
contact.noDirect: Our contact details will be here soon. Until then, reach us through a request on a house page or the owner application.
